# Scene attributes

Every attribute of the nodes, particles and built-in effects of a scene, with the values AnimeLogon accepts. The scene file's other elements are in [scene-format.md](scene-format.md). Any value may instead be `$id`, the value of one of the scene's settings.

- **Default**: the value when the attribute is not written.
- **Moves**: whether a motion (`<keys>`, `<wave>`, `<wander>`, `<drive>`) can move it. An effect's attribute is moved as `<effect id>.<attribute>`, so the effect needs an `id`.
- Distances in effects are fractions of the node's box height unless said otherwise.

## Every node

`<layer>`, `<fill>`, `<particles>` and `<group>` all take these.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | `0` | yes | Where the node's anchor point goes, across: in stage points, or in its group's units inside a group. With `space="screen"`, in percent of the screen's height from the screen's anchor corner. |
| `y` | number | `0` | yes | The same, down. |
| `width` | number, 0 to 100000 | `0` | yes | The box's width. Unwritten (or 0), a layer takes its source's size, a group the extent of its children and a fill or particle emitter the box it is in; when only one of `width` and `height` is written, the other keeps that natural shape. A group's children scale with its box. |
| `height` | number, 0 to 100000 | `0` | yes | The box's height, as for `width`. |
| `anchor` | `top-left` `top` `top-right` `left` `center` `right` `bottom-left` `bottom` `bottom-right` | `top-left` | no | Which point of the box `x` and `y` place. With `space="screen"`, also which corner or edge of the screen they are measured from. |
| `space` | `stage` `screen` | `stage` | no | `stage`: placed on the stage, which covers each screen and may be cut at its sides. `screen`: placed against the screen itself, so it is never cut; its size still follows the stage's scale. |
| `full` | `true` `false` | `false` | no | Covers the box it is in (the stage, at the top level) as `fit` says, centred. `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` and `anchor` are then ignored. |
| `fit` | `cover` `contain` `stretch` | `cover` | no | How a `full` node covers its box: all of it, cutting the overflow (`cover`); all of the node inside it (`contain`); or stretched to it. |
| `pivot` | two numbers, 0 to 1 | `0.5 0.5` | no | The point of the box that `rotation` and `scale` turn and grow about, as fractions of its width and height. |
| `rotation` | number, -36000 to 36000 | `0` | yes | Degrees clockwise about the pivot. |
| `scale` | number, 0 to 100 | `1` | yes | Grows or shrinks the node about its pivot. |
| `scale-x` | number, 0 to 100 | `1` | yes | Grows or shrinks it across only, on top of `scale`. |
| `scale-y` | number, 0 to 100 | `1` | yes | Grows or shrinks it down only, on top of `scale`. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | Opacity of everything the node draws. A group with an opacity below 1 is drawn as one picture and then faded. |
| `blend` | `normal` `add` `screen` `multiply` | `normal` | no | How it lands on what is below: over it (`normal`), adding light (`add`), lightening (`screen`) or darkening (`multiply`). |
| `depth` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | no | How far the camera's motion moves it: 0 not at all (far away), 1 fully (near). Only nodes at the top level take part; a group's children move with the group. A full-screen overlay should say `0`. |
| `mask` | a `<mask>` asset's id | — | no | A mask over the node's box: it shows where the mask is white and is hidden where it is black. |

## `<layer>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | an `<image>`, `<frames>`, `<video>`, `<lottie>` or `kind="layer"` `<shader>` asset's id | — | no | What the layer shows. A frame sequence plays; a video plays stretched to the box; a Lottie animation is drawn at the size it covers; a layer shader draws the box. |
| `fps` | number, 1 to 60 | `24` | no | Frames a second of a frame sequence. |
| `repeat` | `once` `loop` `bounce` | `loop` | no | How a frame sequence plays: once (stopping on its last frame), over and over, or forwards and back. |
| `gap` | seconds, `min-max` or one number | — | no | A frame sequence rests on its first frame this long between runs, a different time from the range each run. `2.5-6` with `repeat="bounce"` blinks an eye. |

## `<fill>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#000000` | yes | The fill's colour. |
| `colors` | colour stops, such as `#000000 0%, #FFFFFF 100%` | — | no | A gradient instead of one colour. |
| `gradient` | `vertical` `horizontal` | `vertical` | no | Which way the gradient runs: top to bottom, or left to right. |

## `<particles>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | an `<image>` or `<frames>` asset's id | — | no | What each particle looks like. Unwritten: a soft dot, or a streak when `stretch` is above 0. |
| `preset` | `rain` `snow` `petals` `fireflies` `stars` `dust` | — | no | A set of defaults (see Presets below). Anything written on the element wins. |
| `rate` | number, 0 to 5000 | `20` | yes | Particles born a second, at most `max` alive at once. The user's particle density setting thins them. |
| `lifetime` | number, 0.1 to 60 | `4` | no | Seconds each particle lives, give or take a fifth. |
| `emit` | `top` `bottom` `left` `right` `point` `line` `area` | `top` | no | Where they are born: just outside one edge of the box, at its centre (`point`), along its middle across (`line`), or anywhere in it (`area`). |
| `speed` | number, 0 to 10000 | `100` | yes | Speed at birth, in points a second, give or take a fifth. |
| `angle` | number, -360 to 360 | `90` | no | Direction at birth, in degrees: 0 right, 90 down, 180 left, 270 up. |
| `spread` | number, 0 to 360 | `10` | no | Directions at birth spread over this many degrees around `angle`. |
| `gravity` | number, -10000 to 10000 | `0` | no | Downward pull, in points a second each second; negative pulls up. |
| `wind` | number, -10000 to 10000 | `0` | yes | The air's drift across, in points a second; particles move with it. |
| `drag` | number, 0 to 10 | `0` | no | How fast a particle's own speed fades, a second; with gravity it settles at gravity / drag. |
| `spin` | number, -3600 to 3600 | `0` | no | Degrees a second each particle turns, half to twice as fast and either way. Each starts at a random angle. |
| `size` | number, 0 to 2000 | `16` | yes | Size in points, give or take 30 percent. |
| `size-end` | number, 0 to 2000 | — | no | Size at the end of a particle's life; unwritten, the same as `size`. |
| `opacity-end` | number, 0 to 1 | — | no | Opacity at the end of a particle's life; unwritten, 1. |
| `color` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | Colour, which also tints a picture. |
| `color-end` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | — | no | Colour at the end of a particle's life; unwritten, the same as `color`. |
| `fade` | number, 0 to 0.5 | `0.1` | no | Share of a particle's life it fades in over, and out over at the end. |
| `seed` | whole number, 0 to 1e+06 | `1` | no | Picks which pseudo-random particles appear. Two emitters with the same settings and seed look the same. |
| `max` | whole number, 1 to 20000 | `2000` | no | Most particles alive at once. All emitters together hold at most 20 000. |
| `fps` | number, 1 to 60 | `24` | no | Frames a second when `source` is a frame sequence. |
| `sway` | number, 0 to 1000 | `0` | yes | Side-to-side drift, in points, each particle at its own pace (2 to 5 seconds a swing); half as much up and down. |
| `twinkle` | number, 0 to 1 | `0` | yes | How far each particle's brightness rises and falls, at its own pace. |
| `stretch` | number, 0 to 1 | `0` | no | Draws each particle as a streak along its motion, as long as it moves in this many seconds. |

## Built-in effects

Written as `<effect type="...">` inside a node.

### `bend`

Sways back and forth, more the farther from its root: hair, a hem, grass. Paint the mask over what moves and where it moves to.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.5` | yes | How far the far end swings: 1 is 12 percent of the box's length from its root. |
| `period` | number, 0.1 to 60 | `3` | yes | Seconds for one swing there and back. |
| `root` | `top` `bottom` `left` `right` | `top` | no | The edge that stays still. |
| `waves` | number, 0 to 4 | `0.25` | yes | How far the far end lags behind the root, in whole swings: 0 swings it stiffly. |

### `breathe`

Grows a little about a point and back: breathing. Use a mask over the chest.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number, 0 to 0.2 | `0.01` | yes | How much it grows at the top of each breath (half as much across). |
| `period` | number, 0.1 to 60 | `4` | yes | Seconds for one breath. |
| `pivot` | two numbers, 0 to 1 | `0.5 1` | no | The point it grows from, as fractions of the box. |

### `wave`

A sine wave travelling across or down it: a flag, a water surface.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | number, 0 to 0.2 | `0.01` | yes | How far it is pushed. |
| `length` | number, 0.01 to 2 | `0.2` | yes | Distance from one crest to the next. |
| `period` | number, 0.1 to 60 | `2` | yes | Seconds for a crest to travel one length. |
| `direction` | `horizontal` `vertical` | `horizontal` | no | Which way the waves travel; the picture is pushed across their direction. |

### `rings`

Ripples spreading in circles from a point.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | two numbers, 0 to 1 | `0.5 0.5` | no | Where the ripples start, as fractions of the box. |
| `amplitude` | number, 0 to 0.1 | `0.01` | yes | How far the ripples push. |
| `length` | number, 0.01 to 1 | `0.1` | yes | Distance between ripples. |
| `speed` | number, 0 to 10 | `1` | yes | Ripples passing a point a second. |

### `flow`

Streaks of disturbance running along a direction: a waterfall, drifting cloud.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | number, -360 to 360 | `90` | no | Direction of the flow in degrees: 0 right, 90 down. |
| `speed` | number, 0 to 10 | `0.2` | yes | How fast the streaks run, in box heights a second. |
| `amount` | number, 0 to 0.2 | `0.02` | yes | How far the streaks disturb the picture. |

### `pan`

Scrolls the picture within its box, wrapping around: a sky that drifts. The picture should tile.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed-x` | number, -10 to 10 | `0` | yes | Box heights a second the picture scrolls across; it wraps around within its box. |
| `speed-y` | number, -10 to 10 | `0` | yes | Box heights a second the picture scrolls down. |

### `jitter`

Jumps to a nearby place several times a second: a shake.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number, 0 to 0.1 | `0.005` | yes | How far it jumps. |
| `rate` | number, 0.1 to 60 | `12` | yes | Jumps a second. |

### `glow`

The bright parts, blurred and added as light. With a mask, only the masked bright parts glow; the light spreads past the mask.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | number, 0 to 4 | `1` | yes | How bright the glow is. |
| `radius` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.02` | yes | How far the glow spreads. |
| `threshold` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.6` | yes | Only parts brighter than this glow (0 to 1). |
| `color` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | The glow's colour, multiplied with the colours that glow. |

### `rays`

The bright parts streaked away from a centre and added as light: light shafts.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | two numbers, 0 to 1 | `0.5 0` | no | Where the light comes from, as fractions of the box. |
| `strength` | number, 0 to 4 | `1` | yes | How bright the rays are. |
| `length` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.5` | yes | How far the rays reach, as a share of the way to the centre. |
| `color` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | The rays' colour. |

### `sheen`

A band of light sweeping across the opaque parts.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | number, -360 to 360 | `30` | no | The direction the band of light crosses, in degrees. |
| `width` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.15` | yes | The band's width. |
| `period` | number, 0.1 to 60 | `4` | yes | Seconds between sweeps; each sweep takes the first third. |
| `strength` | number, 0 to 4 | `1` | yes | How bright the band is. |
| `color` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | The band's colour. |

### `flicker`

Dims and recovers unevenly: a candle, a faulty lamp.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.3` | yes | How dark it can get (0 to 1). |
| `rate` | number, 0.1 to 30 | `3` | yes | How fast it flickers. |

### `grade`

Brightness, contrast, saturation and warmth.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brightness` | number, -1 to 1 | `0` | yes | Added to every colour. |
| `contrast` | number, 0 to 3 | `1` | yes | Spreads colours away from middle grey (above 1) or towards it. |
| `saturation` | number, 0 to 3 | `1` | yes | 0 is grey; above 1 is more colourful. |
| `temperature` | number, -1 to 1 | `0` | yes | Warmer (towards orange) above 0, cooler (towards blue) below. |

### `tint`

Turns the picture into shades of one colour.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | The colour whose shades the picture takes. |
| `amount` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | How fully it is tinted. |

### `blur`

Blurs it. With a mask, only the masked part.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number, 0 to 0.1 | `0.01` | yes | How far it is blurred. |

### `haze`

A rising shimmer: heat haze.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number, 0 to 0.05 | `0.005` | yes | How far the shimmer pushes the picture. |
| `scale` | number, 0.01 to 1 | `0.1` | yes | The size of the shimmer's ripples. |
| `speed` | number, 0 to 10 | `1` | yes | How fast the shimmer rises, in box heights a second. |

### `split`

Pulls red and blue apart: chromatic aberration.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number, 0 to 0.02 | `0.002` | yes | How far red and blue are pulled apart. |
| `angle` | number, -360 to 360 | `0` | yes | The direction they are pulled, in degrees. |

### `grain`

Film grain, fresh 24 times a second.

| Attribute | Value | Default | Moves | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.1` | yes | How strong the grain is. |
| `size` | number, 0.5 to 4 | `1` | yes | The size of a grain, in screen pixels. |

## Particle presets

What each `preset` writes for the attributes the element leaves out.

| Preset | Values |
|---|---|
| `rain` | `rate="300" lifetime="1.2" speed="1400" angle="100" spread="4" size="2" stretch="0.03" color="#B8CCFF99" fade="0.05" max="1500"` |
| `snow` | `rate="40" lifetime="14" speed="50" spread="30" sway="25" size="7" color="#FFFFFFE6" max="800"` |
| `petals` | `rate="12" lifetime="14" speed="70" angle="100" spread="40" sway="45" spin="120" size="16" color="#FFC4D6" max="600"` |
| `fireflies` | `rate="4" lifetime="7" emit="area" speed="15" spread="360" drag="0.4" sway="30" twinkle="0.8" size="9" color="#FFE680" fade="0.2" max="120" blend="add"` |
| `stars` | `rate="60" lifetime="10" emit="area" speed="0" spread="0" twinkle="0.9" size="4" fade="0.3" max="800" blend="add"` |
| `dust` | `rate="15" lifetime="10" emit="area" speed="6" spread="360" sway="12" twinkle="0.3" size="3" color="#FFF4E080" fade="0.25" max="300" blend="add"` |

## Data

Names a `when` condition and a `<drive by>` can read. Numbers drive a property; states are compared with `=` or `!=`.

| Name | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `time` | number | Seconds since the scene started. |
| `clock.day` | number | How far through the local day it is: 0 at midnight, 0.5 at noon. |
| `wake` | number | 0 at rest; rises to 1 while the lock screen fades away after the user wakes it. |
| `battery.level` | number | The battery's charge, 0 to 1. On a PC without a battery it has no value. |
| `media.progress` | number | How far through the playing track, 0 to 1. |
| `date.month` | number | The month, 1 to 12. |
| `audio.level` | number | How loud what the PC plays is, 0 to 1, smoothed. |
| `audio.bass` | number | The same for the low notes. |
| `audio.mid` | number | The same for the middle. |
| `audio.treble` | number | The same for the high notes. |
| `clock.period` | `dawn` `day` `dusk` `night` | The part of the day by the clock: `dawn` 5 to 7, `day` 7 to 17, `dusk` 17 to 19, `night` otherwise. |
| `date.season` | `spring` `summer` `autumn` `winter` | The season by the month, as north of the equator: `spring` March to May, and so on. |
| `battery.state` | `none` `charging` `discharging` `plugged` | What the battery is doing. |
| `power.source` | `none` `battery` `mains` | What the PC runs on. |
| `media.state` | `none` `playing` `paused` | Whether something is playing. |

## Limits

| What | At most |
|---|---|
| `scene.xml` | 256 KB, UTF-8 |
| Nodes, groups included | 64 |
| Group nesting | 4 levels |
| Effects on one node | 8 |
| Effects in the scene | 32 |
| Particle emitters | 8 |
| Particles, all emitters' `max` together | 20000 |
| Pictures and masks (a frame sequence counts once) | 32 |
| Frames in one sequence | 120 |
| Videos | 1 |
| Lottie animations | 4, 16 MB each |
| Shaders | 8, 64 KB of source each |
| Settings | 32 |
| Motions on one node | 16 |
| Keys in one `<keys>` | 64 |
| Video memory of all pictures once compressed | 512 MB (300 MB or less is best) |
| A picture's longer side | 8192 pixels; larger ones are scaled down when imported |
